sources.title: Spatial database for a global assessment of undiscovered copper resources: porphyry copper deposits and prospects (Dicken, Dunlap, Parks, Hammarstrom and Zientek 2016, USGS SIR 2010-5090-Z)
Spatial database for a global assessment of undiscovered copper resources: sediment-hosted stratabound copper deposits and prospects (Dicken and others 2016, USGS SIR 2010-5090-Z)
Porphyry copper deposits of the world: database and grade and tonnage models, 2008 (Singer, Berger and Moring, USGS OFR 2008-1155)
Volcanogenic massive sulfide deposits of the world: database and grade and tonnage models (Mosier, Berger and Singer 2009, USGS OFR 2009-1034)
Compilation of mineral resource data for Mississippi Valley-type and clastic-dominated sediment-hosted lead-zinc deposits (Taylor, Leach, Bradley and Pisarevsky 2009, USGS OFR 2009-1297)
Named deposits compiled for Earth from published tonnage and grade figures (citation per entry in its ref field)
sources.licence: published facts (tonnage, grade, place, date) with a citation per entry; no tables or text copied

notes: mt is the pre-mining ore tonnage (production + reserves + resources) at the source cut-off; grades in grades{} per metal (% except Ag and Au in g/t; W as % WO3). ores[] share a body between its ores by the value each metal adds; an ore's tier follows its own metal's grade through gradeBands (oreMetal). gold (porphyry Cu-Au, VMS, Ag-Au veins) and uranium (Olympic Dam) are ore shares here, graded with the precious group's Au and U bands. Each real deposit is in one group catalogue only, owned by its main commodity by value.

Co-products handed over by iron-ferro: limonite gossans at Rio Tinto and Tharsis (gossanMt: the gossan tonnage included in mt, carried by the limonite share in the top zone; the other metals' grades are over mt - gossanMt) and vanadinite (for descloizite) in the oxidised zone of Berg Aukas, graded with iron-ferro's Fe and V bands.
Tin placers (blankets) carry layers ["alluvial", "outwash"]; hard-rock bodies use the 0060 table (bed, basement).
wulfenite stands in for molybdenite (the game has no molybdenite); tetrahedrite stands in for stibnite.
lens: lenKm along strike, widKm down dip, thickM true thickness; veins: footprint of the swarm, about 3 % of it ore; blanket: tin placers in alluvial ground (0060 class alluvial/outwash).
est lists the fields estimated from the deposit type rules of tools/ore-data/base-metals/build_catalogue.py.
